Help

Error codes

Every code MemoBlok can show you, what it means, and what to do. Generated from the app, so this list is always complete.

Still stuck? In the app, Settings › Report a Problem emails us your recent codes, or write to support@memoblok.com.

On this device

CodeWhat it meansWhat to do
LOCAL-OPENYour Bloks on this device would not open at launch.Tap Load again. If it keeps happening, email support before reinstalling — a reinstall keeps nothing.
LOCAL-READA screen did not get your Bloks from this device.Tap Load again.
LOCAL-WRITEAn entry did not save on this device.Save it again.

Backup

CodeWhat it meansWhat to do
SYNC-OFFLINEBackup is waiting for a connection.Nothing. It goes through when you are back online.
SYNC-DUPLICATEOne entry was already backed up, so this copy stayed on the device.Nothing is lost. Email support if you see it often.
SYNC-PERMISSIONBackup paused because it did not recognize this device's sign-in.Sign in again. Nothing is lost while it waits.
SYNC-INVALIDOne entry was in a shape backup does not take.Email support with this code. A copy of the entry is kept on this device meanwhile.
SYNC-MISSINGOne change was for an entry backup did not have, so the whole entry went up instead of the change.Nothing. This one fixes itself.
SYNC-UNAVAILABLEBackup keeps stopping short of the server.Try again later. Your Bloks stay safe on this device meanwhile.

Sign-in

CodeWhat it meansWhat to do
AUTH-GOOGLEGoogle sign-in stopped before it finished.Try again, or use Apple.
AUTH-APPLEApple sign-in stopped before it finished.Try again, or use Google.
AUTH-SESSIONYour sign-in ran out.Sign in again.

MemoBlok's server

CodeWhat it meansWhat to do
SERVER-UNAVAILABLEMemoBlok's server did not answer.Try again later.
SERVER-FUNCTIONA server step — sharing, or your account — stopped part way.Try again. Email support if it keeps happening.

The App Store

CodeWhat it meansWhat to do
STORE-OFFLINEThe App Store did not answer.Check your connection and try again.
STORE-ALREADYThis Apple ID already has Premium.Tap Restore Purchase.
STORE-PENDINGYour purchase is waiting for approval.Nothing. Premium turns on when it clears.
STORE-NOT-ALLOWEDPurchases are turned off on this device.Check Screen Time or parental settings.
STORE-UNAVAILABLEThe store stopped before the purchase finished.Try again later.

Your phone

CodeWhat it meansWhat to do
NOTIFY-SCHEDULEA reminder did not get set.Set it again.
DEVICE-OPENA link, mail or share sheet did not open.Nothing to fix in MemoBlok. Try the same tap again.

The app

CodeWhat it meansWhat to do
APP-RENDERA screen stopped drawing.Tap Load again.
APP-FATALThe app closed on its own.Open it again.
APP-UNKNOWNSomething the app did not recognize.Email support with this code.
